cards.text: Every motel says I've already checked in.
I'm driving home alone across the country, picking every stop at random.
Tonight's clerk slid me a key and smiled. "Back so soon?"
In room six, the bed was still warm, and the shower was dripping.
I drove two more hours, to a town that wasn't on my map.
That clerk didn't even look up. "Your friend's already in your room."
Outside room six sat my own suitcase. I was still holding mine.
Then Mum texted, "So glad you're finally home."
